name: treechrome
description: TreeChrome：TreeWalker 核心的 TypeScript 实现（平台无关核心库 + Chrome 扩展/评测/控制台多宿主）。架构见 docs/architecture.md

scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks || node -e "console.error('[prepare] git hooks setup failed; pre-commit gate NOT active')"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:gate && pnpm -r run test
